access_used: public sample in paper/repo/card only (full data needs Meta MMCSG Data License registration)
note: No examples: transcripts, RTTM and videos are only distributed after registering for the Meta MMCSG Data License, and no public mirror exists (HF search for mmcsg/chime8 empty). The CHiME page, the paper and the baseline repo (facebookresearch/MMCSG) give only the format, not real rows: one .tsv per recording with "<start-of-word>\t<end-of-word>\t<word>\t<speaker>", speaker 0=SELF (glasses wearer) and 1=OTHER (partner), plus RTTM "SPEAKER <recording-id> 1 <start> <duration> <NA> <NA> <0 or 1> <NA> <NA>" and metadata JSON {self_speaker, other_speaker, noise_category}. The repo lists dev recording ids such as 1044912663445633_0001_3225_21325 (data/perturbation_test_dev) but no transcript text.
